question: What Would You Tell Every Emirati?

answers.text: To be proud to be an emirati
Try to do your best in this life
[She is a Sudanese Resident] Remain connected to our culture -Yeah. Yeah, I agree. -We have to keep it a big part of our life Yeah. Yeah. It's very easy to drift away from it
The more indepth you go in our religion, the more you get closer to Allah.
And every problem that you're going to face is not going to be very difficult, because, he’ll be there to guide you in every single step that you're moving forward in

Enjoy being, a UAE citizen
Be strong and... be in the top because we are on the top
Be strong because you're in the strongest country in the whole world

Be confident within ourselves. I feel like we sometimes hold back a lot because we're too scared of people, calling it nepotism for reaching a certain levels I feel like, you know, as a country we’ve changed so much over time And I feel like as people, we're we're very kind.
